prompt: ALPHA EXTRACTION ONLY of this exact 4-column 6-row 1024x1536 sprite atlas. Preserve every existing painted character pixel, every head, body, costume, glasses, hand, brush, towel and all exact source positions. Do not redraw or reposition or rescale anything. Make the space between ALL 24 sprites fully transparent with clear alpha-zero gaps. Remove only the translucent orange/brown background bridges, halos and tiny stray hair fragments that connect a figure to the next row. Keep each character COMPLETE with all its own fine hair strands, hair loop, shoes, brush and towel. Top two rows stay white/chestnut SHORT SLEEVES and shorts; remaining four rows stay exactly as shown. No background of any kind. Export genuine transparent PNG cutouts, smooth clean edges without glow.
